description: An internal transition written in region `A` of parallel `P` (`T -> .A1`) stays inside `A`, so it does not conflict with `B1`'s `T -> B2`: both are taken in one microstep. `Redo -> .A.A2`, written in `P`, exits and enters only region `A`; `Reset -> .B` resets region `B` alone. `P` is never exited, and the region a transition does not target keeps its state.
